name: editor-superengine
description: Takes a raw talking-head recording all the way to a finished spoken cut: it probes and calibrates the file instead of trusting its container, transcribes with word timestamps, scores trim candidates for a human ruling, verifies every cut boundary against the measured waveform rather than an ASR estimate, tightens gaps in source coordinates, and gates the whole cut against a silence budget before anyone listens to it. Then it runs the design-iteration loop for the reel's visuals: divergent direction comps over real plates, parametric ladders for craft tweaks, measured verification, and rulings taken from frames instead of prose. For people editing short-form talking-head reels for Instagram and TikTok who want the boring verification done properly. It is not a captioner and not a compositor: captions, sound design and final compositing come after picture lock and live elsewhere.
